title: NewsFile
description: v1/meta/news.json. Recent headlines about the European grid, cross-border flows, data centers and AI power demand, taken from public RSS and Atom feeds. Each item has only a title, a link, the publisher name and a date. No article text or images. Since 1.2.0.

items.description: Newest first. At most 2 items per publisher and 8 in total. Titles are unique.

title.description: Headline as the publisher wrote it, as plain text.

url.description: Link to the article on the publisher's site.

source.description: Publisher name, e.g. Clean Energy Wire.

published_at.description: Publication time from the feed, in UTC, or null if the feed has no valid date.
